skills.name: sfh-ci-monitoring
skills.description: Write SimpleFlowHarness flows that watch or repair CI. Use for bounded GitHub Actions polling, exact run selection and routing CI conclusions.

skills.name: sfh-context-workspace
skills.description: Choose SimpleFlowHarness workspaces, context bundles and session handoffs. Use when steps share files or knowledge, a loop loses state, or execution inputs must survive resume.

skills.name: sfh-deterministic-gates
skills.description: Map evidence to SimpleFlowHarness routes. Use when exit codes, outcomes, labels, AI verdicts or fan-out votes decide the next step.

skills.name: sfh-eval-engineering
skills.description: Turn a failed SimpleFlowHarness run into a regression evaluation. Use to diagnose recurring failures or improve the flow from recorded evidence; use sfh-loop-engineering for the loop graph itself.

skills.name: sfh-failure-recovery
skills.description: Handle failed or interrupted SimpleFlowHarness runs. Use when choosing retry, fallback, replay, resume, workspace adoption or carried budgets, especially with uncertain side effects.

skills.name: sfh-flow-design
skills.description: Write or refactor SimpleFlowHarness YAML from a task. Use for a new flow or a change to its overall execution graph.

skills.name: sfh-flow-review
skills.description: Review an existing SimpleFlowHarness YAML flow. Use to find concrete control-flow, evidence, recovery or portability defects before execution.

skills.name: sfh-loop-engineering
skills.description: Design bounded feedback cycles in SimpleFlowHarness. Use for review/fix or planner/worker/evaluator loops, repeated route visits, or a loop that stalls.

skills.name: sfh-tool-integration
skills.description: Connect external CLIs, web/API tools or MCP-enabled agents to SimpleFlowHarness. Use when defining their invocation, output, identity or permission contract.
